ko: 가진 것이 적어도 감사하며 사는 삶
en: Happiness is to live a pure life though it may not be luxurious Happiness is to be thankful though I may not have a lot

ko: 내게 주신 작은 힘 나눠주며 사는 삶
en: Yet I have much to share though it may seem so small Oh happiness, this I have, Happiness with joy

ko: 눈물 날 일 많지만 기도할 수 있는 것
억울한 일 많으나 주를 위해 참는 것
en: I can go to Jesus in prayer though my tears may falling down I can endure many wrongs and I know it’s for the Lord

ko: 비록 짧은 작은 삶 주 뜻대로 사는 것
en: In this short and temporal world, happiness is to live out God’s will Oh happiness, this I have, Happiness with joy

ko: 세상은 알 수 없는 하나님 선물
en: Happiness, this is my Happiness with joy The awesome present of my God, the world can never know
Happiness, this is my Happiness with joy
Knowing that I’m a child of God, No one can deny
